snippet.title: MISDAMNATION | Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
In this poignant story influenced by RPG Maker classics and psychological horror, you’re Div, an ill-fated soldier robbed of his memories and identity. Navigate the surreal dystopia poised for revolt, ponder moral dilemmas, and discover who you used to be, before they’ve branded you as a monster.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4713070/Misdamnation/

Follow us for updates:
The Gubi Games Studio website: https://thegubigames.com/
Official Instagram: https://instagram.com/envvu_devvs
